title: Training plan
description: The training plan as data, in its decoded (in-memory) shape after normPlan. Web app storage: localStorage goa:plan (this object, or key absent) and db doc state/plan as {plan: Plan|null}. In the db the inner week arrays are wrapped as {__arr:[...]} by dbEnc, because the db refuses an array directly inside an array; decode with dbDec before validating. A null or absent plan means 'use the default protocol', which is rebuilt from the goal and profile every time (defaultPlan) and never stored. The previous plan lives in state/planprev and goa:planprev as {plan: Plan|null, kcal: number|null, protein: number|null}; see $defs/planPrev.

by.description: Who made it. normPlan maps anything else to 'default'.

at.description: Epoch ms of the last change, or null for the default plan.

note.description: Short note on the change, e.g. 'Targets edited' or the request sent to Claude (sliced to 80).

programs.description: Sessions keyed by program key. normPlan keeps at most 16 programs, strips the key to [A-Za-z0-9_-] and 24 characters, and drops programs with no valid exercises. Default keys: homeA, homeB, bodyA, bodyB, fullA, fullB, lowerA, upperA, lowerB, upperB.

phases.description: Exactly four phases (base, build, push, sharpen). Their week ranges are not stored: phaseBounds() splits the training weeks roughly 23.5% / 35.3% / 29.4% / remainder.

targets.description: Daily macro targets in grams. Calories and protein are NOT here: they live on the goal.

kit.description: Equipment context. home and body use the home alternate-exercise pool; gym uses the gym pool. normPlan maps unknown values to 'gym'.

exerciseLine.description: Pipe-delimited 'name|scheme|cue'. name up to 90 chars; scheme up to 30 chars and must contain a digit, e.g. '3 × 8-10', '3 × 30 s / side' (normPlan rewrites '3x10' to '3 × 10'); cue up to 400 chars, may be empty. The scheme's first number before '×' is the planned set count; a scheme whose reps part contains 's' or 'sec' is a timed hold (reps field then holds seconds). Logged sets are matched to exercises by exact name, so renaming starts a fresh history.

name.description: e.g. 'Phase 1 · Base'. The text after the last '·' is used as the short label.

steps.description: Daily step target during this phase.

weeks.description: One or two week layouts of 7 slots. Odd plan weeks use weeks[0], even weeks use weeks[1] when present (that is how session A/B alternate). Slot index 0 is the weekday of goal.trainStart, not Monday.

slot.description: One day of a plan week.

s.description: Program key; must exist in programs or normPlan turns the slot into cardio.

c.description: Cardio to do after the session.

planPrev.description: Shape of state/planprev and goa:planprev: the plan that was replaced plus the calorie and protein targets at the time, for 'Restore previous plan'. Written by savePlan. When nothing was ever replaced the db doc is {plan:null}.

plan.description: The replaced plan, or null when it was the default.
